name: scan_flags_and_update_position
description: Counts a timer byte up to a limit, scans an eight-entry flag table backwards for the highest nonzero slot, and then selects a lookup-table pair to write two position bytes and a sprite value. Several branches write to the same status fields before looping back.

name: apply_damage_and_report_kill
description: Subtracts a damage byte from a stored value in a table; when the value is used up it clears the entry, writes the status bytes and returns, with the 'KILLED! EXP.-' text marking the kill path.

name: dispatch_bytecode_opcode
description: Reads an opcode byte and dispatches across about thirty cases that set timers, counters, flags and copied bytes, with one branch doing decimal-adjusted subtraction on a stored two-digit value. Unhandled cases fall to a common exit that writes the default timer value.

name: update_entity_positions_loop
description: Runs the same table scan and position update as its neighbouring movement routine, but with a larger set of opcode and status checks that select which lookup table feeds the position bytes. It loops until the per-entity counter reaches its limit.

name: find_position_table_match
description: Adds two delta bytes to a candidate x and y pair, rejects it when either coordinate passes ten, and otherwise scans a table backwards for an entry with the same pair and stores its index. A miss loads a fallback value and joins the shared position update loop.

name: check_tile_code_before_move
description: Compares an entity code byte against a few fixed values, one of which triggers an extra call, then falls into the shared position update loop that scans the flag table and writes the coordinate bytes.

name: check_flag_before_update
description: Returns to the shared position update routine after a single flag comparison: when the input byte equals one fixed value it takes an extra call first, and otherwise it goes straight to the common update code.

name: move_player_by_direction
description: Handles the directional step for the entity named by the PLR text, adding a direction offset to the two position bytes and masking them to four bits for the wrap-around cases, then rejoining the shared update loop.

name: run_shared_movement_update
description: Entry point into the shared position update loop that reads the current coordinates, scans the flag table for a nonzero slot, and handles the direction and opcode branches. It ends by writing the updated coordinate bytes.

name: run_full_entity_update_pass
description: Runs the longest version of the shared position update, with extra opcode checks and a table scan that resets a counter before the coordinates are written. It ends once the update loop has no remaining entries.

name: clear_indexed_table_slot
description: Selects one of two byte tables based on a flag, uses the low bits of a value as an index into it, and clears that slot when it is nonzero before returning the value. A zero index returns the value unchanged.

name: run_fixed_routine_sequence
description: Makes a fixed sequence of four calls and returns. The only other evidence is a reference to the PLR text, so it is a thin wrapper around player-related work.

name: replace_status_code_if_zero
description: Masks the low two bits of a value and, when they are zero and a status byte holds a fixed code, replaces that code with another and calls routines before returning the masked value.

name: skip_null_terminated_strings
description: Walks forward through the global byte string, passing one NUL-terminated string for each count in the counter register, and returns the pointer's new position.

name: advance_past_null_strings
description: Walks forward through the global byte string, passing one NUL-terminated string for each count in the counter register, and then returns. It is a single-instruction string skipper that other text routines call.

name: skip_string_run_from_pointer
description: Walks forward from the caller's pointer through NUL-terminated strings, passing one for each count in the counter register, and returns after one call to an unnamed routine.

name: handle_steal_prompt_move
description: Checks a direction byte and a range test before moving the two position bytes by a scaled offset, and for one case it writes a fixed code to the status byte. It sits beside the 'Plr to steal-' text and then runs the shared movement tail that handles the two-state flag and the timer bytes.

name: move_entity_without_prompt
description: Runs the same movement tail as its neighbour without the steal-text branch, using the direction and range checks to adjust the position bytes and replacing one table value with a fixed code in a 64-entry scan.

name: handle_direct_move_command
description: Runs a movement step tied to the DIRECT text, adding a scaled offset to the position bytes when the range check passes and then replacing one table value with a fixed code. It then runs the shared tail that branches on movement state values zero, one and two.

name: replace_marker_bytes_then_move
description: Scans a 64-entry table and replaces each entry equal to the letter H with a fixed high code, then runs the shared movement tail that dispatches on the state byte and the timers.

name: apply_masked_offset_then_move
description: Checks that the input byte falls in a fixed range and, if so, adds a doubled offset to the two position bytes and tests for a dollar-sign code. It then masks a table entry into the status byte and runs the shared movement tail.

name: handle_transact_action_step
description: Checks a status byte and a tile code, and on the matching path sets a state byte to a fixed value and steps a decimal-coded counter toward a limit; otherwise it applies the range and offset checks before the shared tail. The 'Transact!' text is the only other clue to its purpose.

name: handle_direct_action_step
description: Runs the same range and offset checks as its neighbour under the DIRECT text, and when a specific global value matches it calls an unnamed routine before the shared movement tail. It also steps a decimal-coded counter toward a limit on one path.

name: check_tile_then_move
description: Checks that the input byte is below a limit and adds a doubled offset to the position bytes, then for an at-sign tile code it handles one special case or calls a routine on the global state. It then runs the shared movement tail.

name: handle_at_tile_move
description: Adds a stored offset to the two position bytes and, when the tile code is an at-sign, either leaves early for one special position or saves the state byte into a global and calls an unnamed routine. It then runs the shared movement tail.

name: check_special_position_then_save
description: Tests a global value and two position bytes against fixed constants and, on a match, runs one unnamed call; otherwise it saves the state byte into a global and runs the shared movement tail.

name: save_state_and_resume_move
description: After a single zero-flag test, saves the state byte into a global, calls an unnamed routine when that global holds a fixed value, and then runs the shared movement tail.

name: store_state_then_move
description: Copies the state byte into a global when the zero flag is set, calls an unnamed routine for a fixed global value, and then falls into the shared movement tail.

name: save_state_with_global_check
description: Copies the state byte into a global and calls several unnamed routines, with one branch for a fixed global value, before writing the saved state back and running the shared movement tail.

name: save_state_after_call
description: Makes one unnamed call, copies the state byte into a global and into the saved position byte, then runs the shared movement tail.

name: step_decimal_counter_on_tile
description: Compares a table entry with the letter L and, depending on that and a low-nibble test, either sets a global to a fixed value and steps a decimal-coded counter toward its cap or does nothing, before the shared movement tail.

name: branch_on_low_nibble_flag
description: Tests the low four bits of an indexed table entry and calls one of two unnamed routines accordingly, then runs the shared movement tail.

name: enter_shared_movement_tail
description: Makes one unnamed call and then joins the shared movement tail, with no checks of its own.

name: step_decimal_counter_when_flagged
description: When the zero flag is clear, sets a global to a fixed value and steps a decimal-coded counter toward its cap with the same threshold and nibble logic, then runs the shared movement tail.

name: step_decimal_counter_with_limits
description: When the zero flag is set, sets a global to a fixed value and checks the decimal counter against a threshold and a flag bit before stepping it and running the shared movement tail.

name: step_decimal_counter_capped
description: Sets a global to a fixed value and steps a decimal-coded counter toward its cap when a comparison against the same limit and flag bit passes; otherwise it makes unnamed calls before the shared tail.

name: increment_bcd_counter_capped
description: Steps a decimal-coded counter up by one with decimal correction and a cap when its input value is under a threshold and a guard passes, and otherwise makes one unnamed call.

name: increment_bcd_counter_guarded
description: Steps a decimal-coded counter up by one with decimal correction and a cap when a guard passes, then makes four unnamed calls before the shared tail; the other path makes a single call.

name: increment_bcd_counter_direct
description: Adds one to a decimal-coded counter with decimal correction and a cap, makes four unnamed calls, and enters the shared movement tail through a label.

name: call_routine_before_tail
description: Makes one unnamed call and then joins the shared movement tail through a second label.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_on_code
description: When the state byte is not one and a flag byte is zero, a status code matching a fixed value decrements a decimal-coded counter with decimal correction and sets the output byte to twice a stored value before the shared tail.

name: decrement_counter_on_unlock_attempt
description: Refers to the Unlock and WHOSE KEY texts. When a flag byte is zero and a status code matches a fixed value, it decrements a decimal-coded counter and sets the output byte to twice a stored value before the shared tail.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_if_nonzero
description: When a decimal-coded counter is nonzero, decrements it with decimal correction, sets the output byte to twice a stored value, and then runs the shared movement tail.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_unchecked
description: Decrements a decimal-coded counter from the input value with decimal correction, sets the output byte to twice a stored value, and then runs the shared movement tail without a zero check.

name: advance_channel3_volume_step
description: Advances a four-step index, reads a pair of words from two tables for that step, and copies one into a global. The audio channel three volume register is the hardware it touches, and it then runs the shared tail.

name: equip_item_from_prompt
description: Checks a slot number below five and looks up a character code in a table, then converts it to an item code and stores that code into the equipment table, unless the slot is already occupied. The Wear for prompt text is the only label for it.

name: equip_armour_item
description: Checks the slot number is at most four, looks up a character code, and stores the resulting item code into the equipment table when that entry is free. The ARMOUR text marks it as the armour variant.

name: store_equipment_item_code
description: Adds a fixed bias to an input byte to form an item code and, when that entry in the equipment table is free, stores the code into the equipment slot. Otherwise it jumps to the loop label.

name: store_selected_item_into_slot
description: Copies the selected item byte into the equipment slot and joins the label that leads into the shared tail.

name: lookup_item_threshold_byte
description: Stores the input byte, searches an eleven-entry table for the character in a fixed slot, and compares the matching table threshold with the stored byte; both outcomes return, so it only records the value.

name: handle_exit_state_change
description: Refers to the X-it text. When the state byte is not a fixed value it may call an unnamed routine, and for a small input value it saves the doubled state byte and sets the state to a fixed value before the shared tail.

name: save_exit_state_if_small
description: When the state byte is not a fixed value and a small input value holds, saves a doubled state byte and sets the state to a fixed value before the shared tail. The X-it text marks this exit prompt.

name: store_exit_state_unchecked
description: Saves a doubled state byte into the output and sets the state byte to a fixed value, then runs the shared movement tail with no checks.

name: match_typed_name_input
description: Collects typed key codes into a buffer with a backspace-style counter until an end code, then checks the buffer against several fixed codes. The Yell, whom text marks the prompt, and a match updates a stored code and a counter before the shared tail.

name: call_then_enter_shared_tail
description: Makes one unnamed call and then joins the shared movement tail through a label, with no checks of its own.

name: toggle_animation_frame_byte
description: When the state byte is zero, a flag bit is set and a position byte equals ten, it toggles a frame byte between two fixed values, then makes unnamed calls and runs the shared movement tail.

name: set_animation_frame_value
description: Sets the frame byte to one fixed value and joins the shared movement tail through its label.

name: set_alternate_animation_frame
description: Sets the frame byte to the alternate fixed value and joins the shared movement tail through its label.

name: run_four_calls_before_tail
description: Makes four unnamed calls and then joins the shared movement tail through its label.

name: store_seven_bit_value
description: Masks the input word to its low seven bits, stores the result in a status byte, and calls an unnamed routine before joining the shared tail when a stored byte is nonzero.

name: handle_stats_for_prompt
description: Refers to the Ztats for text. It makes several unnamed calls and branches on a zero-flag test before joining the shared movement tail.

name: store_codes_into_tables
description: Reads a sequence of codes and, using a threshold test, records each one into one of two tables at fixed offsets or passes it over. It then sets the two frame bytes to a fixed value before joining the shared movement tail.

name: update_level_display_frames
description: Sets two frame bytes to fixed values, increments a decimal-coded level with decimal correction, sets two more frame bytes, and makes several unnamed calls. The Good text is the only other label.

name: apply_record_list_to_frames
description: Walks a list of three-byte records until a negative terminator, copies two bytes from each record into the frame bytes, and calls an unnamed routine once for each count in the record.

name: build_eight_entry_menu_list
description: Fills an eight-entry list with pointers into a twelve-byte-stride table, marks the entry that matches a stored slot with a different code, and writes a sentinel once all eight are done. The SKIN text is the only other label.

name: build_sixteen_entry_menu_list
description: Fills a sixteen-entry list with pointers into a twelve-byte-stride table, marks the entry matching a second stored slot, and writes a sentinel at the end. The HAND and HANDS texts are the only labels.

name: advance_frame_byte_after_calls
description: Makes two unnamed calls and then increments the frame byte by one before returning.

name: step_frame_byte_after_call
description: Makes one unnamed call and then increments the frame byte by one before returning.

name: emit_flagged_death_entries
description: Refers to the Death text. For each of three byte pairs it tests one bit of a status byte and, when that bit is set, writes a stored value into the frame byte, calls an unnamed routine and advances the second frame byte.

name: repeat_calls_for_count
description: Reads a count byte from the pointer and makes two unnamed calls for each step of that count, then returns.

name: count_string_bytes
description: Counts the bytes at a pointer offset before the first zero byte and returns that count.

name: read_buffered_byte_with_flags
description: Returns the next byte from a buffered stream structure, refilling it through an unnamed routine when its count is exhausted and setting error or end flags when a refill fails. It returns all ones when an error flag is already set.

name: read_buffered_byte_via_frame
description: Reads the next byte from the buffered stream held at the caller's pointer, with the same refill and flag logic as its neighbouring reader.

name: read_buffered_byte_direct
description: Reads a byte from the buffered stream using its stored count and refills through an unnamed routine when the count runs out. It skips the initial zero-count refill that its neighbours perform.

name: read_buffered_byte_after_flag
description: Marks a buffered stream as in use, refills it through an unnamed routine and records end or error status, then returns the next byte. It returns all ones when the stream is already flagged as errored.

name: refill_and_read_stream_byte
description: Marks a buffered stream as in use, refills it through an unnamed routine, records empty or error status, and returns the next byte, or all ones when the status shows an error.

name: read_next_buffered_byte
description: Decrements the buffer count and returns the next byte from the buffer, or calls an unnamed refill routine when the count was already exhausted.

name: call_stream_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine with the stream pointer and returns, without any checks of its own.

name: write_buffered_byte_with_flush
description: Writes a byte into a buffer structure while decrementing its remaining count, and when the count underflows it calls an unnamed flush routine. It sets error or end flags in the structure from the result and returns all ones on failure.

name: initialize_buffer_structure
description: Returns early when the structure already has a buffer and a flag bit is clear; otherwise it calls an unnamed routine and stores the returned pointer in two fields. A null result sets a fixed error code and returns failure, while success clears the mode bits and zeroes the counters.

name: dispatch_keyword_from_table
description: Skips an optional minus sign, a dot and a trailing lowercase l, then scans a small fixed table of keyword codes and calls the handler stored with the match. It returns zero when nothing matches.

name: pad_and_copy_field_text
description: Copies a text field into a buffer with padding: it writes the fill character for the leading count, copies the string bytes, then writes the trailing padding and stores the final length in the result slot.

name: write_padded_field_variant
description: Performs the same padded field copy as its neighbour from a later entry point, and stores the final length in the result slot.

name: write_padded_field_tail
description: Finishes padded field output from a shared body, padding before and after the source bytes depending on the alignment flag, and then stores the total length in the result slot.

name: fill_remaining_padding_chars
description: Writes the fill character a counted number of times into the buffer, stores the final length in the result slot and returns one more than a stored field width.

name: fill_then_copy_field_text
description: Writes the fill character for one counted run, copies the string bytes for the remaining count, stores the total length and returns one more than a stored field width.

name: copy_field_text_bytes
description: Copies string bytes into the buffer for a counted length, stores the total length in the result slot, and returns one more than a stored field width.

name: copy_value_and_increment_counter
description: Stores the value held in the frame slot into the structure field the frame pointer names, and returns one more than a stored counter. It performs a single store and a single addition.

name: format_numeric_field_width
description: Sets a default width of six when the width is unset and clamps it to nineteen, calls an unnamed routine to format the digits, and computes the sign and padding counts for the field. It then records the state for the next write.

name: compute_exponent_padding_width
description: Calls an unnamed routine to produce digits, then computes the sign and padding counts from the magnitude, adding a digit when the value exceeds ninety-nine or nine hundred ninety-nine. It then clears the mode flag.

name: pad_and_emit_number_text
description: Computes the length of the formatted number from its sign, digit and exponent counts, pads the remainder with the fill character when it falls short of the width, and writes the characters into the buffer.

name: emit_number_digits_and_sign
description: Adds the exponent digit count to the length, writes padding and a minus sign where required, and emits the digits from the source string into the buffer.

name: emit_decimal_digits_with_point
description: Writes the minus sign, the leading zero and decimal point, and the remaining digit characters, padding with zeros when the digit count runs out.

name: write_exponent_suffix
description: Writes a leading minus sign when needed, then the integer digits, a decimal point and the fractional digits, followed by the exponent letter E with its own sign and digits. This is the scientific-notation output path.

name: emit_fixed_point_digits
description: Emits integer-part digits or zeros for a counted run, then the fractional digits when the mode flag is set, pads with the fill character up to the width, stores the length and returns a count one greater than a stored value.

name: emit_zero_padded_fraction
description: Writes zero characters for a counted run and then the fractional digits, pads with the fill character up to the width, and stores the final length in the result slot.

name: emit_digits_and_point
description: Emits digits from the source for the integer count, writes a decimal point when the fraction count is nonzero, then emits the fractional digits and pads up to the width.

name: emit_zero_run_and_fraction
description: Writes a run of zeros, a decimal point when the fraction count is nonzero, and the fraction digits, then stores the length and returns a count one greater than a stored value.

name: emit_point_digits_and_pad
description: Writes a decimal point when fraction digits remain, then the digit characters and padding up to the width, and stores the final length in the result slot.

name: emit_digit_run_with_pad
description: Writes zeros or digits for a counted run, pads the remainder when the mode flag is set, stores the final length and returns a count one greater than a stored value.

name: emit_fraction_then_exponent
description: Writes integer digits or zeros, a decimal point and the fraction digits, then the exponent letter E with a sign, updating the result length.

name: emit_exponent_digits_from_buffer
description: Writes a zero integer part, the decimal point and fraction digits, then the exponent letter, its sign and digits converted through a temporary eleven-character buffer.

name: emit_exponent_with_sign
description: Writes zero or digit characters for the fraction run, then the exponent letter with its sign and the exponent digits from a temporary buffer, and pads the rest.

name: emit_exponent_suffix_digits
description: Writes the exponent letter and a sign, converts the exponent digits through a temporary buffer, and copies that buffer into the output with padding.

name: emit_positive_exponent_digits
description: Writes a plus sign, converts the exponent digits through a temporary eleven-character buffer, copies them into the output and pads when the mode flag is set.

name: pad_and_store_result_length
description: Pads the output with the fill character up to the width when the mode flag is set, stores the final length in the result slot and returns a count one greater than a stored value.

name: store_length_and_return_count
description: Stores the value in the frame slot into the result field and returns one more than a stored counter. It performs one store and one addition.

name: set_attack_state_from_table
description: Refers to the Attack text. When a flag byte is zero it reads a table entry, derives a state code from its bits and stores it, and for one specific value it writes a fixed code before the shared movement tail.

name: set_state_from_table_entry
description: Reads a table entry and derives a state code from its middle bits, storing it in the output byte and clearing the table entry, with a fixed-code branch for one value before the shared movement tail.

name: reset_map_state_and_marks
description: Copies a global value into the state byte, clears two counters and sets one byte to a fixed value, then replaces each L or H entry in a 32-entry table with a fixed code. It finishes by running the shared movement tail.

name: select_board_state_from_key
description: Refers to the Board text. When the state byte is a fixed value it reads one key code and, for an opening-parenthesis or comma code, stores a fixed output and state pair before the shared tail.

name: select_state_from_key_code
description: Reads one key code and, for an opening-parenthesis or comma code, stores a fixed output and state pair before joining the shared movement tail.

name: set_state_to_fourteen
description: Sets the output byte to four and the state byte to a fixed value, then joins the shared movement tail.

name: set_state_to_sixteen
description: Sets the output byte to zero and the state byte to another fixed value, then joins the shared movement tail.

name: prepare_cast_target_prompt
description: Refers to the Cast by whom text. It sets a timer byte to a fixed value, copies a target index into a second byte and, when the index is nonzero, repeats that copy before joining the shared movement tail.

name: enter_shared_tail_from_label
description: Makes several unnamed calls and joins the shared movement tail through a label, with no checks of its own.

name: subtract_cost_and_dispatch_effect
description: Classifies a code byte into a group, derives an effect index, and when a stored value covers a cost it subtracts that cost with decimal correction. It then dispatches on the effect index to set the effect bytes before the shared tail.

name: cast_spell_by_class
description: Refers to the cleric, wizard and spell-type texts. It classifies the class code, subtracts a decimal-coded cost when the stored value covers it, and dispatches on the effect index through a large switch before the shared tail.

name: call_three_return_first
description: Makes three unnamed calls in sequence and returns the value produced by the first one, ignoring the other two results.

name: set_flags_when_state_idle
description: When the state byte is a fixed value and a second byte matches, sets a flag and a timer value, then scans eight table entries and calls routines for each nonzero entry that passes a low-bit test before the shared tail.

name: handle_direct_command_target
description: Refers to the DIRECT text. It sets a status bit and, when the state byte is a fixed value, reads the position bytes from the table, then stores a looked-up value in a working byte before the shared tail.

name: set_timer_ten_and_tail
description: Sets one counter byte to ten, makes two unnamed calls and joins the shared movement tail.

name: increment_counter_below_seven
description: When the state byte is one and an unnamed check passes with the counter below seven, increments that counter and jumps to the label of the shared tail; otherwise it runs the tail directly.

name: increment_counter_copy_pairs
description: Increments a counter byte, then reads coordinate pairs through unnamed calls until a zero value, and copies the last pair into the position bytes before the shared tail.

name: decrement_counter_copy_pairs
description: When the state byte is one, decrements a counter byte if it is nonzero, then reads coordinate pairs through unnamed calls until a zero value and copies the last pair into the position bytes before joining the shared tail.

name: set_value_and_read_pair
description: Sets one byte to a fixed value and, when the state byte is a fixed value, reads a position pair from the table and stores a looked-up value in a working byte before the shared tail.

name: read_triplets_until_terminator
description: When the state byte is zero and a second byte is not a fixed value, reads groups of three bytes until a terminator of four, keeps the last two as position bytes and then joins the shared tail.

name: set_doubled_and_read_pair
description: Reads a byte and stores twice its value in one byte, then when the state byte is a fixed value reads a position pair from the table and stores a looked-up value in a working byte before the shared tail.

name: set_timer_large_and_tail
description: Sets one counter byte to a fixed high value, makes two unnamed calls and joins the shared movement tail.

name: apply_cost_and_switch_effect
description: Classifies a code byte into a group, subtracts a decimal-coded cost from a stored value when it covers the cost, then dispatches on the effect index with a fixed-state branch and a counter update before the shared tail.

name: set_value_and_scan_table
description: Sets one byte to a fixed value and, when the state byte is a fixed value, scans eight table entries with a low-bit test and calls routines for each match before the shared tail.

name: scan_table_entries_backwards
description: Walks a counter downward through table entries, calling routines for each nonzero entry that passes a low-bit test, and then joins the shared tail.

name: set_maximum_and_read_pair
description: Sets one byte to its maximum value and, when the state byte is a fixed value, reads a position pair from the table and stores a looked-up value in a working byte before the shared tail.

name: set_counter_twenty_and_tail
description: Makes one unnamed call, sets one counter byte to a fixed value of twenty, then joins the shared movement tail.

name: double_value_and_scan_table
description: Reads a byte and stores twice its value in one byte, then when the state byte is a fixed value it scans eight table entries with a low-bit test and calls routines for each match before the shared tail.

name: mark_table_entries_with_five
description: When the state byte is a fixed value, walks eight table entries and sets each nonzero entry to five, calling a routine for each one before the shared tail.

name: mark_table_entries_downward
description: Walks eight table entries downward, setting each nonzero entry to five and calling a routine for it, and then joins the shared tail.

name: store_pair_and_return_code
description: Copies an indexed table value into both position bytes, makes unnamed calls, stores a fixed code and then the stored state byte into the output, and returns.

name: set_maximum_and_scan_table
description: Sets one byte to its maximum value and, when the state byte is a fixed value, scans eight table entries with a low-bit test and calls routines for each match before the shared tail.

name: set_flag_and_scan_table
description: When the state byte is a fixed value and a second byte matches, sets a flag and one byte to its maximum value, then scans eight table entries with a low-bit test and calls routines for each match before the shared tail.

name: read_status_byte_then_tail
description: Reads a byte into a status byte and, when it is nonzero, makes several unnamed calls before joining the shared movement tail.

name: prompt_heal_target_selection
description: Refers to the HEAL WHOM text, then makes several unnamed calls before joining the shared movement tail.

name: copy_pairs_until_zero_value
description: When the state byte is one, reads coordinate pairs through unnamed calls until a zero value and copies the last pair into the position bytes, then joins the shared tail.

name: prompt_cure_target_selection
description: Refers to the CURE WHOM text. When a flag is clear it makes unnamed calls and, when a status byte holds a fixed high code, replaces it with another code before the shared tail.

name: set_status_from_input_range
description: Copies the position bytes, then for an input byte in a fixed range it sets an output byte from its low bits, and for an at-sign code it sets the output to zero. When a flag is set it reads a value and sets a status byte from its low bits before joining the shared movement tail.

name: restore_saved_position_and_check
description: Restores the position bytes from their saved copies, clears the state byte and makes several unnamed calls. It then compares read values with fixed bytes to choose a follow-up code before the shared tail.

name: store_read_status_and_tail
description: Reads a byte into a status byte and, when it is nonzero, makes several unnamed calls before joining the shared movement tail.

name: clear_position_and_reset_global
description: Clears the two position bytes, saves a global value, sets that global to a fixed value and restores it, then joins the shared movement tail.

name: dispatch_state_one_or_two
description: Sets globals to fixed values and decrements a counter if it is nonzero, then dispatches on the state byte: value one runs a read loop and value two runs a second loop with an unnamed call before the shared tail.

name: update_status_code_by_bits
description: When the state byte is not a fixed value and a status byte holds a fixed code, sets the status byte to one of two other codes depending on the low bits of a read value, before the shared tail.

name: set_status_to_fixed_code
description: Sets a status byte to a fixed code and joins the shared movement tail.

name: subtract_five_and_set_status
description: Refers to the RECALL WHOM text. When a status byte holds a fixed code and the state is not a fixed value, it subtracts five from a decimal-coded value with decimal correction, sets the status to another fixed code and makes unnamed calls before the shared tail.

name: enter_shared_tail_label
description: Makes two unnamed calls and joins the shared movement tail through its label, with no checks of its own.

name: enter_shared_tail_only
description: Makes one unnamed call and joins the shared movement tail, with no checks of its own.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls another unnamed routine four times in succession and then returns, with no other operations on data.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Makes one unnamed call and returns.

name: call_three_then_return_registers
description: Makes three unnamed calls and returns the two data-register values as a pair, unchanged.

name: handle_descend_prompt_entry
description: Refers to the Descend text. It makes several unnamed calls and joins the shared movement tail through labels.

name: handle_enter_prompt_entry
description: Refers to the Enter text and makes one unnamed call before joining the shared movement tail.

name: find_location_and_set_mode
description: Scans a table of twenty position pairs backwards for the entry matching the current position and stores its index. It then sets a map mode, position and counter from a tile code of ten, twelve or fourteen, updates a global from that mode and joins the shared tail.

name: set_mode_from_matched_entry
description: Checks two input values against the position bytes, stores the matched index and sets a map mode from a tile code in the same way as its neighbour. It then updates a global from the mode and joins the shared tail.

name: set_mode_from_tile_code
description: Sets a map mode, position and counter from a tile code of twelve or fourteen, then updates a global from the mode and joins the shared tail.

name: set_mode_from_tile_fourteen
description: Sets a fixed mode, position and counter for one specific tile code, then updates a global from the mode and joins the shared tail.

name: enter_shared_tail_directly
description: Makes one unnamed call and joins the shared tail through a label, with no checks of its own.

name: update_global_from_mode
description: Adds a fixed offset to a stored index and copies it into a global. When the mode is one it clears two fields, and otherwise it sets the global to the mode, to seven or to three depending on a comparison, before the shared tail.

name: set_global_seven_or_three
description: Sets a global to seven when one position byte matches it and to three otherwise, then joins the shared tail.

name: set_global_three_and_tail
description: Sets a global to three and joins the shared tail.

name: resolve_direction_code_loop
description: Clears the status and timer fields, computes a status code from an at-sign test, and runs a loop over a fixed number of input codes that handles two direction codes with masked offsets. It writes the position bytes at the end.

name: set_global_eleven_on_code
description: When a code byte equals a fixed value, sets a global to eleven after its checks and then joins the shared tail.

name: set_global_eleven_on_flag
description: When the zero flag is set, makes unnamed calls, sets a global to eleven after a special-value check, then joins the shared tail.

name: set_global_eleven_after_check
description: Makes unnamed calls, sets a global to eleven after a special-value check, and joins the shared tail.

name: set_global_eleven_direct
description: Makes unnamed calls, sets a global to eleven, and joins the shared tail.

name: run_fire_projectile_steps
description: Refers to the Fire text. When a state byte is a fixed value it steps a point four times with a wrap mask, checks each landing table entry and sets output codes for hits, before the shared tail.

name: step_projectile_four_times
description: Steps a point four times with a wrap mask, checks each landing table entry and sets output codes for hits, then joins the shared tail.

name: step_projectile_loop_entry
description: Steps a point through a four-step loop with a wrap mask, checks each landing table entry for hits and writes output codes for them, then joins the shared tail.

name: call_twice_then_tail
description: Makes two unnamed calls and joins the shared tail through a label.

name: clear_hit_table_entry
description: Stores an index byte, checks the table entry it selects against a threshold and, for a hit, copies the entry into the output and clears it before joining the shared tail.

name: clear_entry_into_output
description: Uses a sign flag to choose a path through unnamed calls, then copies an indexed table entry into the output byte and clears that entry before continuing into the shared tail.

name: store_stack_value_and_tail
description: Copies a value from the stack frame into the output byte, makes an unnamed call and joins the shared tail through a label.

name: set_secondary_status_maximum
description: Sets a secondary status byte to its maximum value, makes unnamed calls and joins the shared tail.

name: conditional_call_then_tail
description: Makes unnamed calls, skipping one when the zero flag is set, and joins the shared tail through a label.

name: set_output_from_input_range
description: Copies the position bytes and, for an input byte in a fixed range, sets an output byte from its low bits; for an at-sign code it sets the output to zero. When a secondary byte is nonzero it chooses a status code from the low bits of a read value before the shared tail.

name: call_once_and_enter_tail
description: Makes one unnamed call and joins the shared tail through a label.

name: zero_output_for_at_sign
description: When a code byte is an at-sign, sets the output to zero; when a secondary byte is nonzero it selects a status code from the low bits of a read value and runs a count-based loop over a table before the shared tail.

name: set_output_and_status_loop
description: Reads a secondary byte and, when it is nonzero, chooses a status code from the low bits of a read value, running a count-based loop over a table in one branch before the shared tail.

name: decode_masked_index_pair
description: Reads a byte and, when it is below a threshold, combines it with further reads masked to three or two bits to form an index. It calls unnamed routines for each nonzero result before the shared tail.

name: decode_masked_index_status
description: Decodes a masked index from input bytes in the same way as its neighbour and, when a flag is clear, makes unnamed calls and sets a status byte to a fixed code before the shared tail.

name: skip_call_when_zero_flag
description: Makes two unnamed calls, skipping the last when the zero flag is set, then joins the shared tail through a label.

name: count_down_and_call_routines
description: Loads a counter from a stored byte and counts it down past zero, making unnamed calls on each pass and on the final step, then returns.

name: decode_masked_index_with_loop
description: Runs a count-based loop that sets a status byte to a fixed code on its final pass, then decodes a masked index from input bytes and joins the shared tail.

name: return_result_unless_zero_flag
description: Makes one unnamed call and returns its value when the zero flag is clear; otherwise it makes two more calls and returns zero.

name: call_twice_return_zero
description: Makes two unnamed calls and returns zero.

name: decode_masked_index_for_gold
description: Refers to the GOLD+ text. It decodes a masked index from input bytes, calling unnamed routines for each nonzero result, and then joins the shared tail.

name: decode_masked_index_prompt
description: Refers to the AND A text. It decodes masked index values from input bytes, calling unnamed routines for each nonzero result, and joins the shared tail.

name: decode_masked_index_and_text
description: Refers to the AND text. It decodes a masked index from input bytes, calling unnamed routines for each nonzero result, before the shared tail.

name: call_once_then_tail_label
description: Makes one unnamed call and joins the shared tail through a label.

name: handle_target_selection_keys
description: Refers to the TO PLR text and the F, G, E, W and A key list. It swaps the two index bytes and branches on specific key codes, assigning a selected item index and calling unnamed routines before the shared tail.

name: clear_flag_and_enter_tail
description: Clears a flag byte, makes an unnamed call and joins the shared tail through labels.

name: prompt_amount_entry_step
description: Refers to the AMOUNT text. It makes several unnamed calls and, when a flag byte is zero, copies a stored index into the frame index before joining the shared tail.

name: restore_index_and_enter_tail
description: Copies the stored index byte into the frame index, makes unnamed calls and joins the shared tail through labels.
